managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.users
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Stores user login data within a secure schema.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.refresh_tokens
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Store of tokens used to refresh JWT tokens once they expire.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.instances
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Manages users across multiple sites.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.audit_log_entries
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Audit trail for user actions.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.schema_migrations
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Manages updates to the auth system.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.identities
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Stores identities associated to a user.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.sessions
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Stores session data associated to a user.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.mfa_factors
managed_and_public_tables.comment: auth: stores metadata about factors

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.mfa_challenges
managed_and_public_tables.comment: auth: stores metadata about challenge requests made

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.mfa_amr_claims
managed_and_public_tables.comment: auth: stores authenticator method reference claims for multi factor authentication

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.sso_providers
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Manages SSO identity provider information; see saml_providers for SAML.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.sso_domains
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Manages SSO email address domain mapping to an SSO Identity Provider.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.saml_providers
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Manages SAML Identity Provider connections.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.saml_relay_states
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Auth: Contains SAML Relay State information for each Service Provider initiated login.

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.flow_state
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Stores metadata for all OAuth/SSO login flows

managed_and_public_tables.name: auth.oauth_client_states
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Stores OAuth states for third-party provider authentication flows where Supabase acts as the OAuth client.

managed_and_public_tables.name: public.profiles
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Public application profile connected one-to-one with Supabase auth.users.

managed_and_public_tables.name: public.receiving_reports
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Source-neutral Foodhouse receiving header. production_team receipts have no PO; direct_supplier receipts remain PO-backed. Only post_receiving_report authoritatively posts stock.

managed_and_public_tables.name: public.receiving_report_items
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Foodhouse receiving line. Production Team lines identify inventory directly; direct supplier lines identify a PO item, which determines inventory. Accepted quantities create batches and linked ledger movements when posted.

managed_and_public_tables.name: public.inventory_batches
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Phase 6B.3 structural batch record. Future posting must require use_by_date on every receiving batch whose inventory item has expiry_required = true. No legacy-opening rows are created by this migration.

managed_and_public_tables.name: public.inventory_opening_balances
managed_and_public_tables.comment: One-time, verified Foodhouse cutover count per batch-managed inventory item. Zero counts are recorded here without creating a batch or ledger movement.

managed_and_public_tables.name: public.inventory_transaction_batch_allocations
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Positive child allocations that reconcile one confirmed-order inventory issuance to the exact physical batches consumed.

managed_and_public_tables.name: public.paid_order_cancellations
managed_and_public_tables.comment: Manager-attested, completed full refund and preparation-aware inventory disposition. Waste/no_return means sale issuance remains consumed; it is not a second stock deduction.
